title: The 10 Best Cordless Leaf Blowers
subtitle: Battery-powered leaf blowers and sweepers for yards, driveways and decks, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless leaf blower clears leaves, clippings and debris without gas, oil or a pull cord. We ranked 10 best-sellers from EGO, DEWALT, Greenworks, BLACK+DECKER and budget brands on rating, review volume and features (450 CFM or more, a battery in the box, variable speed and a turbo boost). Compare CFM and MPH, not motor RPM.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 530 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with 2.5Ah Battery (LB5302)
products.best_for: Homeowners who want a proven EGO for a typical lot.
products.verdict: EGO's long-running blower, with 6,702 reviews: 530 CFM on turbo, a variable speed dial and the same 2.5Ah battery as the LB6151.
cons: Lower air speed than newer EGOs

products.name: EGO POWER+ 765 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with 5.0Ah Battery (LB7654)
products.verdict: A step below the 880 with 765 CFM and a 5.0Ah battery for up to 90 minutes, for half-acre-plus yards.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 615 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with 2.5Ah Battery (LB6151)
products.best_for: Most suburban yards: leaves, grass clippings and driveways.
products.verdict: The best-value EGO: 615 CFM on turbo, a speed dial with cruise lock and up to 75 minutes on the included 2.5Ah battery.

specs.extras: Speed dial 200-480 CFM with lock-on button

products.name: EGO POWER+ 880 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with Two 4.0Ah Batteries (LB8803-2)
products.best_for: Large properties and wet, matted leaves where gas used to be the only option.
products.verdict: EGO's most powerful handheld here: 880 CFM and 200 mph on turbo, a digital display and two 4.0Ah batteries for up to 90 minutes.

products.name: Greenworks 40V Cordless Leaf Blower, 135 CFM, 2.0Ah Battery and Charger
products.best_for: Hard surfaces and light leaves around the house.
products.verdict: A light 40V sweeper for patios, decks, porches and garage floors, with a variable speed dial and a 3-year warranty, for under $80.

specs.extras: Variable speed dial, concentrator nozzle, 3-year warranty

products.name: MZK 20V Cordless Leaf Blower, Lightweight (ET1613)
products.best_for: Budget buyers who don't own a battery platform.
products.verdict: A budget 20V blower that claims 600 CFM and 200 mph with a battery in the box, for about $50.

products.name: YOOVL Cordless Leaf Blower, 650 CFM, 2 x 5.2Ah Batteries, 3 Speeds (LB-8184)
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want long runtime from two big packs.
products.verdict: A budget kit with two 5.2Ah batteries, three speeds and a shoulder strap, and one of the best sellers here.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Compact Blower, 100 CFM, Variable Speed, Tool Only (DCE100B)
products.best_for: DEWALT owners clearing sawdust, workbenches and car interiors.
products.verdict: Not a leaf blower so much as a jobsite and shop blower: 100 CFM for blowing out joints, benches, cars and garages on a DEWALT battery. It's the best seller here.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX Cordless Sweeper Blower with Battery and Charger (LSW221)
products.verdict: The most-reviewed blower here: a 3.7 lb sweeper for driveways, decks and garages, with a battery and charger in the box.

products.name: WOLFMEN Cordless Leaf Blower, 450 CFM, 2 Batteries and Charger, 2 Speeds (LB-8197)
products.best_for: Small yards on a budget, with a spare battery.
products.verdict: A budget blower with two batteries and an axial fan rated 450 CFM and 150 mph, more believable than the six-figure-RPM claims around it.

avoid.name: 990,000 RPM Cordless Leaf Blower with 2 Batteries and Charger, Electric Handheld Blower
avoid.flag: Claims 990,000 RPM; gives no CFM or air speed
avoid.verdict: A tiny handheld blower sold on a '990,000 RPM' motor claim, with no airflow or air-speed figure anywhere in the listing.
reasons: 990,000 RPM is a meaningless number for a blower; what moves leaves is airflow (CFM) and air speed (MPH), and the listing gives neither.
It lists '26+ mins total runtime' from two batteries combined, about 13 minutes per battery.
The 4.8-star rating sits on 457 reviews. For about the same money, the MZK and WOLFMEN blowers state their airflow, and EGO's LB6151 is rated at 615 CFM.

buyers_guide.a: CFM (cubic feet per minute) is how much air moves; MPH is how fast. CFM moves piles of leaves; MPH lifts wet, stuck debris. Look at both. A blower with high MPH and low CFM is fine for patios, not for a lawn full of leaves.

buyers_guide.q: How much CFM do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 100 to 200 CFM clears patios, decks and garages. 400 to 600 CFM handles most suburban yards. 700 CFM and up competes with gas blowers for big properties and wet leaves.
Budget listings advertise motors at 800,000 to 990,000 RPM. RPM tells you nothing about airflow. Skip blowers that don't list CFM and MPH.
If you'll add a trimmer, mower or chainsaw, buy into one platform (EGO, Greenworks, DEWALT, BLACK+DECKER) so batteries swap between tools. Budget kits' batteries usually fit nothing else.

buyers_guide.q: How long will the battery last?
buyers_guide.a: On turbo, minutes, not hours. EGO lists up to 75 to 90 minutes at low speed. Use the lowest setting that works and save turbo for stubborn spots.
